mapper.insert: insert into product (merchant_id, category_id, business_type, name, image, description, price, stock, sales, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{categoryId}, #{businessType}, #{name}, #{image}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from product where id = #{id} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.select: select * from product where category_id = #{categoryId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
select count(*) from product where category_id = #{categoryId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
